bull.b: The clear shift from volatile Bitcoin mining to contracted HPC leasing creates more predictable, recurring revenue and higher adjusted margins. Early 117% QoQ HPC growth and improving adjusted EBITDA indicate durable structural revenue diversification and lower exposure to crypto price swings.

Material cash reserves and a funded CapEx pipeline provide runway to execute large-scale campus builds without immediate capital raises. This financing cushion supports multi-quarter development cadence and reduces near-term execution risk while assets are commercialized.

bull.t: Long-term Anthropic Lease and Asset Monetization
bull.b: A multi-decade Anthropic lease delivers substantial long-term contracted revenue visibility and anchors the company's role as an AI infrastructure provider. Concurrent JV monetization frees capital to accelerate wholly owned campus builds, improving revenue quality and strategic focus.

bear.t: Negative Operating and Free Cash Flow
bear.b: Consistent negative operating cash flow and deeply negative FCF mean core operations do not self-fund expansion. Sustained cash burn necessitates continued equity, asset sales, or debt, increasing dilution and execution risk if contracted leases or monetizations slip.

Negative equity and previously extreme leverage materially reduce financial flexibility and borrowing capacity. Balance-sheet volatility raises refinancing and covenant risk, making multi-quarter execution dependent on successful asset sales and sustained profitability improvements.

bear.t: Large GAAP Losses from Noncash Volatility
bear.b: Substantial noncash warrant fair-value swings and impairment charges drive headline losses that can persist unpredictably and distort underlying operating performance. Ongoing accounting volatility risks complicating stakeholder confidence and reported metrics over multiple quarters.
